column1: # DeloWay default applications — the one catalog of alternatives offered for each role.
# Read by install.sh (terminal menus), the Setup Wizard and Settings → Apps
# (shell/services/DefaultApps.qml). Installed apps of the same kind that are not listed
# here are offered too; this list adds the ones worth installing.
#   role      browser | terminal | fileManager | editor | monitor
#   desktop   desktop-entry id (without .desktop), used for icons, xdg defaults, the Dock
#   package   Arch package that provides it
#   default   "default" marks the preselected choice of the role (exactly one per role)
